known_limitations: The Python connector is unpaged and the implementation fails closed at 300 rows per request; requests are therefore split into at most 31 calendar days.
The Python model says YEAR while the verified physical schema is DAY/WAL/DEDUP=false; the Java isolated target preserves the physical layout and no formal migration is proposed.
The natural key is trade_date, but the physical target has no UPSERT key. Updates require a verified same-schema full-snapshot stage and journaled table replacement.
Full-table stage snapshots are bounded at 100000 rows and 64 MiB; larger target snapshots fail closed.
The five-day revision overlap is calendar days and is limited to existing verified coverage.
The independent operational helper and publication/recovery paths have not been exercised against a live D027 target.
